description: Verify ownership of an agent endpoint before it can be registered in Argus Console: checks that the verify token is served at https://<endpoint>/.well-known/argus-verify.txt. Run once per endpoint, right after the user adds the agent in Argus Console and shares the verify token. Does not consume any quota.

endpoint.description: Public base URL of the agent, e.g. https://my-agent.replit.dev

token.description: Verify token from Argus Console → Agents

name: argus_verify_agent
